statement: Let a_s = max(0, s-(n-1)), b_s = min(s, m-1), L_s = b_s-a_s+1 for 0 <= s <= m+n-2, and let D_s be the list of length L_s with D_s[k] = mat[a_s+k][s-(a_s+k)] for 0 <= k < L_s. Let start_s = sum_{t=0}^{s-1} L_t. The function returns a result r such that len(r) = m*n and, for every s with 0 <= s <= m+n-2 and every k with 0 <= k < L_s, r[start_s+k] = D_s[k] when s is odd, and r[start_s+k] = D_s[L_s-1-k] when s is even.
preconditions: Let m = len(mat) and n = len(mat[0]). The input satisfies m >= 1, n >= 1, m*n <= 10000, every row mat[i] has length exactly n for 0 <= i < m, and -100000 <= mat[i][j] <= 100000 for all 0 <= i < m and 0 <= j < n. All indices are 0-based.
